personality.summary: Norman is formal and cool, executing Union headquarters' delicate decision: the Union will not officially intervene, but Edelweiss will be transported as an independent actor.

abilities_owned: Aozora no Mon / Azure Gate teleportation network

relationships.edelweiss: Transports her to Japan despite her being a Union/League enemy because the crisis requires independent action.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Appears in his command room and delivers the chairman order.
relationships.white-beard: Acts as the messenger of White Beard's chairman order.

periods.summary: Norman appears in Japan Branch command via teleportation while Itsuki is speaking with Vermillion. He brings Edelweiss and announces White Beard's chairman order: the Union will not officially intervene in Stella's kidnapping. The meaning is political—formal Union involvement would split member states and delay action, while Edelweiss can move immediately by her own justice. Norman's arrival enables Edelweiss to reinforce the battlefield in time.

key_events.summary: Teleports to Japan with Edelweiss and conveys the Union's nonintervention order.
